subject: Request: 72-hour pilot extension while purchasing completes
messages:
From: Samir Kapoor <samir.kapoor@medicore.com>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.com
Cc: procure@medicore.com
Date: Sun, 20 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — pilot access while PO clears

Hi Aisha,

Hope you're well. We're at the tail end of our internal purchasing approvals for the Redwood pilot (PO was submitted last week) but finance needs one more vendor verification step — they told us it could take 3–5 business days. Our product team is mid-integration and losing access right now would pause validation work that’s time-sensitive.

Any chance Redwood can keep the pilot environment live for an extra 72 hours while procurement finishes? We can't commit to a contract yet until our vendor intake is complete, but we can share the invoice (#MC-0427) and additional compliance docs if that helps.

Thanks for considering — Samir

Samir Kapoor

Hi Samir — thanks for the note and for sending the invoice. Sorry to hear procurement is stretched.

We can usually support short runway extensions in cases like this. Before I lock anything in, two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the anticipated PO clear date (finance estimate is fine)
- Can your security/ procurement team confirm that there are no new onboarding blockers (SOW/insurance/KYC) beyond the vendor verification step?

If those are OK, I can propose a 72-hour sponsored credit buffer so your team can finish integration without interruption. Ben, Marissa — looping you both for quick approval on a small temporary credit (<= $2k equivalent) and to confirm we tag usage to RDW-4672 for reconciliation.

Action: Samir — reply with the PO ETA and any onboarding blockers.

Best,

Appreciate the transparency, Samir. We reviewed the invoice and usage data (attached pilot-usage-report.csv) and have approved a one-time 72-hour extension. Details:
- Credit: $1,800 (applied as trial credits)
- Window: 2027-06-22T15:00:00-07:00 through 2027-06-25T15:00:00-07:00
- Billing tag: RDW-4672 / Medicore Health pilot
- Conditions: credits applied only to the sandbox workload; any paid usage after the window will be billed per normal pricing.

We'll turn the credit on at 15:00 PT today. Please reply if procurement clears sooner and you'd like us to convert to normal billing earlier. I'll also attach the internal note for finance.

Thanks — happy to help keep the integration on schedule.
